Business problem it helps solve: Explain PV/load deviations per 15 min (curtailment, eclipse, dust, weather vs. fault); lost-energy attribution; forecast correction. Public data to build & prove the product (licence: non-commercial)
Who pays (customer): PV owners & O&M, aggregators / traders (BRPs), DSOs
Variables: Generation by source incl. solar, wind; load; prices (not redistributable)
Licence / terms: Free for non-commercial & journalistic use, credit 'Energy-Charts / Fraunhofer ISE'
Example documented events: Eclipses 20 Mar 2015, 25 Oct 2022, 29 Mar 2025, 12 Aug 2026; Iberian blackout 28 Apr 2025; COVID-19 lockdowns 2020; holidays; Saharan dust
Open expert-knowledge sources: ENTSO-E eclipse & incident reports; NASA eclipse catalogue; IEA PVPS reports; Fraunhofer ISE reports

Business problem it helps solve: Same as E1 for a commercial product, plus outage reasons (REMIT UMMs) for traders; incident analysis

Licence / terms: ENTSO-E terms of use (free reuse with attribution for most data)
Example documented events: Same as E1 + unit outages (each with a published reason code)
Open expert-knowledge sources: ENTSO-E incident investigation reports (2006, 2021 split, 2025 blackout)
